content.user_title: Track Project Plans in AI Sessions
content.value_statement: AI coding sessions can lose track of project plans when notes are stale or missing. This skill checks plan status and suggests the right save or sync action.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether docs/PLAN.md exists or is missing.
Identifies stale plans using last modified time and recent git activity.
Suggests session actions for missing plans, stale plans, uncommitted work, and resumed sessions.
Keeps docs/PLAN.md as the stated source of truth for project status.
Uses lightweight heuristics and does not edit plan files directly.
limitations: It does not create, update, or archive plan files by itself.
It depends on docs/PLAN.md and available git context.
Its staleness checks are heuristic and may need human review.
Suggested slash commands must exist in the user environment.

use_cases.title: Resume a coding session
use_cases.description: Review the current plan state before starting work and choose the next sync action.

use_cases.title: Keep team planning notes current
use_cases.description: Spot when recent commits or uncommitted changes make the plan outdated.

use_cases.title: Guide AI-assisted project tracking
use_cases.description: Ask an assistant to check plan freshness and suggest clear follow-up actions.

prompt_templates.title: Check the plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner check for plan presence and freshness.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether this project has a current docs/PLAN.md and tell me what action to take next.

prompt_templates.title: Resume work safely
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a new AI coding session with project context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-planner to review docs/PLAN.md before I start coding. Tell me whether the plan needs a sync, status review, or save action.

prompt_templates.title: Compare plan with git activity
prompt_templates.scenario: Review stale plan signals after recent development.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare docs/PLAN.md with recent git activity and uncommitted work. Identify stale sections and recommend the most appropriate session action.

prompt_templates.title: Audit planning workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of planning health across a project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use project-planner to assess plan freshness, missing decisions, and progress gaps. Provide prioritized follow-up actions without editing files.

output_examples.input: Check the project plan before we start.
output_examples.output: docs/PLAN.md exists, but recent commits appear newer than the plan. Recommended action: sync from git activity, then review the current progress section.

output_examples.input: We just made progress and need to update planning notes.
output_examples.output: The plan may need a save action because the user mentioned progress. Capture the new decisions and update the in-progress items.

output_examples.input: Is there a plan for this project?
output_examples.output: No docs/PLAN.md was found. Recommended action: create an initial plan from the current goals before continuing implementation work.

best_practices: Review plan status at the start of each AI coding session.
Save planning notes after major decisions, completed work, or changed goals.
Compare the plan with git activity before relying on older status notes.
anti_patterns: Expecting the skill to edit or archive plan files automatically.
Treating heuristic stale-plan signals as final project truth.
Ignoring missing docs/PLAN.md while continuing complex implementation work.

faq.question: What does this skill monitor?
faq.answer: It monitors docs/PLAN.md and checks whether the project plan appears missing, stale, or ready for review.

faq.question: Does it modify files?
faq.answer: No. The skill only suggests actions. Plan changes are handled by separate session commands or user actions.

faq.question: How does it decide a plan is stale?
faq.answer: It uses heuristics such as plan age, recent git commits, uncommitted work, and user mentions of progress.

faq.question: Can it work without git?
faq.answer: It can still check for docs/PLAN.md, but git-based freshness signals will be limited.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it a project management system?
faq.answer: No. It is a lightweight planning assistant for keeping local project notes aligned with development activity.
